with current as (
  select alarm_name as alertname,host,datasource as m_datasource,alarm_name as m_notif_plugin,plugin_instance as m_notif_plugin_instance,
        type as m_notif_type,DATE_TRUNC('hour',(alert_time)) as updated1, 1 as count
  from 
  (
    ${view_alerts_pg:text}
  )as q
  where  (site_name_from_alert is not null AND site_name_from_alert != '')
)


select updated, 
      count(*)+ (select case when DATE_TRUNC('hour',now())>updated then count(count) else 0 end  from current where  updated1<=updated ) as count
from( 
   select alertname,host,m_datasource,m_notif_plugin,m_notif_plugin_instance,m_notif_type, DATE_TRUNC('hour',now()) as updated,1 count 
  from current

  group by alertname,host,m_datasource,m_notif_plugin,m_notif_plugin_instance,m_notif_type,updated1 

)as q
group by updated

select case
           when '${type_hub}' = 'if_packets' then 'pps'
           when '${type_hub}' = 'if_octets' then 'bps'
           else '' end                as Unit,
       from_iso8601_timestamp(time) time,
       (sum(tx) * ${unit_change_bit}) as tx,
       (sum(rx) * ${unit_change_bit}) as rx
from (select time,host,iface,
             (avg(tx / duration)) as tx,
             (avg(rx / duration)) as rx
      from (select time,
                   q.host,
                   q.iface,
                   (max_tx - min_tx) as tx,
                   (max_rx - min_rx) as rx,
                   duration
            from (
                  ${view_interface_with_all_hubs_and_type_filter:text}
            ) as q
            left join (
                  ${view_tenant_host_overlay_iface:text}
            ) as s on q.host = s.host AND s.iface like  q.iface|| '%' 
            -- AND q.iface = s.iface 
            where time is not null AND s.islanif = 'false') as r
      group by time, r.host, r.iface) as q
group by time
order by time

select  s.host,
    trim(
        both ' '
        from concat(
            case
                when floor(max_by(uptime, l.last_check) / 86400) >= 1
                    then format(
                        '%d days ',
                        cast(floor(max_by(uptime, l.last_check) / 86400) as integer)
                    )
                else ''
            end,
            case
                when floor((max_by(uptime, l.last_check) % 86400) / 3600) >= 1
                    then format(
                        '%d hours',
                        cast(floor((max_by(uptime, l.last_check) % 86400) / 3600) as integer)
                    )
                else ''
            end
        )
    ) as uptime,
    operational_status,
		--t.ishub_value, 
		--true is_configured
    vlan.lan_ip,
    listagg(case when islanif = 'false' then  ip_address else null end, ' - ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY case when islanif = 'false' then  ip_address else null end)  as wan_ip,
		case when operational_status = 'ACTIVE' then 'Up' else 'Down' end as control_plane_status,
		site_name,template_version,maya_os_version,
		administrative_status,  
		case when cast(latitude  as double) is null then 0 else  cast(latitude  as double) end +  (random() / 10000) latitude, 
		case when cast(longitude  as double) is null then 0 else  cast(longitude  as double) end +  (random() / 10000) longitude 
from  (
  ${view_tenant_host_overlay_iface:text}
)   as s
left join (
        SELECT
            id,
            array_join(flatten(array_agg(CAST(lan_ip AS array(varchar)))),' , ' ) AS lan_ip
        FROM tenant.public.site
        WHERE lan_ip IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY id,lan_ip
) as vlan on cast(vlan.id as varchar) = s.host
left join ( ${view_uptime:text}  )as l on s.host = l.host
where  s.host is not null AND uptime is not null
--and host != '' and (  '${sites:csv}' = '-' or regexp_count(host  , '${sites:regex}')>0)
group by s.host,site_name,operational_status,administrative_status,latitude,longitude,template_version,maya_os_version,vlan.lan_ip
order by s.host

select
	i.*,
	device.maya_os_version
from
	maya_tenant.otlp_metric."
    --ttl=150
    --refresh=20
    --cache=false
    --name=Data Plane Status Sites And Overlays
    --columns=host,site_name,type,iface,operational_status,administrative_status,is_configured
    --dbtype=pg
	select
		s.id host,
		s.created_at,
		s.updated_at,
		'?' mac_addres,
		s.name site_name,
		stvs.type,
		split_part(coalesce(osr.interface_name,trim( both  '""' from cast(stvs.name as text) )), '.', 1) as iface_with_split,
        coalesce(osr.interface_name,trim( both  '""' from cast(stvs.name as text) )) as iface,
		osr.overlay_name  as overlay_name,
		trim( both  '""' from cast(stvs.name as text) )  as overlay_iface_name,
		coalesce(osr.public_ip,stvs.ip_address) ip_address,
		coalesce(cast(stvs.bandwidth as integer),10485760) bandwidth,
		s.id || '-'||  trim( both  '""' from cast(stvs.name as text) ) as jn,
		coalesce( coalesce((s.location->>'latitude')::float,(parent_site.location->>'latitude')::float ), 0) AS latitude,
		coalesce( coalesce((s.location->>'longitude')::float,(parent_site.location->>'longitude')::float ), 0) AS longitude,
		s.operational_status,
		s.administrative_status,
		'?' as location_group,
		osr.carrier_type as carrier,
		case when osr.role = 'HUB' then 'true' else 'false' end ishub_value,
		stvs.islanif,
		stvs.protect as is_mng_iface,
		true is_configured,
		template_name,
		trim( both  '""' from cast(stvs.template_version as text) ) template_version,
        trim( both  '""' from cast(s.device::jsonb->'id' as text) ) device_id,
        trim( both  '""' from cast(s.device::jsonb->'modelId' as text) ) model_id
	from site s
	left join (
		select *
		from(
			Select site_id,
			   template_version_id,
			   tv.site_config_data::jsonb->'template'->>'name' template_name,
			   tv.site_config_data::jsonb->'version' template_version,
			   trim(both '""' from (e->'name')::text )   as name,
			   trim(both '""' from (e->'ethernet'->'address')[0]::text ) as ip_address,
			   trim(both '""' from (e->'ethernet'->'bandwidth')[0]::text ) as bandwidth,
			   'ethernet' as type,
--			   o->'name'->'ishub' AS ishub_value,
--			   trim(both '""' from (o->'namename')::text )  AS overlay_name,
--			   trim(both '""' from (o->'name'->'wanif')::text )  AS overlay_iface_name,
			   e->'ethernet'->'islanif' AS islanif,
			   e->'ethernet'->'protect' AS protect
			FROM site_temp_version_state tv,
				 jsonb_array_elements(tv.site_config_data::jsonb->'interfaces'->'ethernet'  ) e
--				 jsonb_array_elements(tv.site_config_data::jsonb->'overlay'->'name') o
			where (tv.site_config_data::jsonb->'interfaces'->'ethernet')::text != 'null'
--					and e->'name' = o->'name'->'wanif'
 
			union
 
			Select site_id,
			   template_version_id,
			   tv.site_config_data::jsonb->'template'->>'name' template_name,
			   tv.site_config_data::jsonb->'version' template_version,
			   trim(both '""' from (e->'name')::text )   as name,
			   trim(both '""' from (e->'wwan'->'address')[0]::text ) as ip_address,
			   trim(both '""' from (e->'wwan'->'bandwidth')[0]::text ) as bandwidth,
			   'wwan' as type,
--			   o->'name'->'ishub' AS ishub_value
--			   trim(both '""' from (o->'namename')::text )  AS overlay_name,
--			   trim(both '""' from (o->'name'->'wanif')::text )  AS overlay_iface_name,
			   e->'wwan'->'islanif' AS islanif,
			   e->'ethernet'->'protect' AS protect
			FROM site_temp_version_state tv,
				 jsonb_array_elements(tv.site_config_data::jsonb->'interfaces'->'wwan'  ) e
--				 jsonb_array_elements(tv.site_config_data::jsonb->'overlay'->'name') o
			where tv.site_config_data::jsonb->'interfaces'->'wwan'::text !='null'
					and tv.site_config_data::jsonb->'overlay'::text !='null'
--					and e->'name' = o->'name'->'wanif'
 
			union
 
			Select site_id,
			   template_version_id,
			   tv.site_config_data::jsonb->'template'->>'name' template_name,
			   tv.site_config_data::jsonb->'version' template_version,
			   trim(both '""' from (e->'name')::text )   as name,
			   trim(both '""' from (e->'bonding'->'address')[0]::text ) as ip_address,
			   trim(both '""' from (e->'bonding'->'bandwidth')[0]::text ) as bandwidth,
			   'bonding' as type,
--			   o->'name'->'ishub' AS ishub_value
--			   trim(both '""' from (o->'namename')::text )  AS overlay_name,
--			   trim(both '""' from (o->'name'->'wanif')::text )  AS overlay_iface_name,
			   e->'bonding'->'islanif' AS islanif,
			   e->'ethernet'->'protect' AS protect
			FROM site_temp_version_state tv,
				 jsonb_array_elements(tv.site_config_data::jsonb->'interfaces'->'bonding'  ) e
--				 jsonb_array_elements(tv.site_config_data::jsonb->'overlay'->'name') o
			where tv.site_config_data::jsonb->'interfaces'->'bonding' ::text !='null'
					and tv.site_config_data::jsonb->'overlay'::text !='null'
--					and e->'name' = o->'name'->'wanif'
 
		) as i1
	)as stvs   on  stvs.site_id = s.id
					-- and stvs.template_version_id = s.template_version_id
	left join overlay_site_relation osr on  osr.site_id = s.id and osr.template_version_id = stvs.template_version_id
        and  stvs.name  =  split_part(coalesce(osr.interface_name,trim( both  '""' from cast(stvs.name as text) )), '.', 1) 
	left join site parent_site on  parent_site.id = s.parent_id
    where s.device is not null
	order by s.id
 
    " as i
	left join envanter.public.device device on i.device_id = cast(device.id as varchar)

WITH labels AS (
  SELECT
    ai.rule_uid,
    ai.current_state,
    ai.labels_hash,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0='grafana_folder'           THEN e->>1 END) AS sensor,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0='host'                    THEN e->>1 END) AS host,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0='m_notif_plugin'          THEN e->>1 END) AS alarm_name,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0='m_notif_plugin_instance' THEN e->>1 END) AS plugin_instance,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0='m_notif_type'            THEN e->>1 END) AS type,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0='m_notif_type_instance'   THEN e->>1 END) AS type_instance,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0='m_datasource'            THEN e->>1 END) AS datasource,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0='m_currentvalue'          THEN e->>1 END) AS currentvalue,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0='max_date_num'            THEN e->>1 END) AS max_date_num,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0='status'                  THEN e->>1 END) AS last_status,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0='notification_a'          THEN e->>1 END) AS notification_description,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0='site_name_a'             THEN e->>1 END) AS site_name_from_alert,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0='m_overlay'               THEN e->>1 END) AS m_overlay,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0='m_iface'                 THEN e->>1 END) AS m_iface,
    max(CASE WHEN e->>0='m_notif_plugin'          THEN e->>1 END) AS atmp3_v  -- same as alarm_name for your CASE usage
  FROM alert_instance ai
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(ai.labels::jsonb) AS e
  WHERE lower(ai.current_state) NOT IN ('pending','normal')
  GROUP BY ai.rule_uid, ai.current_state, ai.labels_hash
),
active_silenced AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT trim(both '"' from a.value::text) AS silenced_hash
  FROM maya_silence ms
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(ms.silenced_alerts::jsonb) a
  WHERE lower(ms.status::jsonb ->> 'state') = 'active'
),
last_anno AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (a.alert_id)
    a.alert_id,
    lower(a.prev_state) AS prev_state,
    lower(a.new_state)  AS new_state
  FROM annotation a
  ORDER BY a.alert_id, a.id DESC
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN lower(l.last_status) = 'failure' THEN 'Alerting'
    WHEN lower(l.last_status) = 'warning' THEN 'Warning'
    ELSE l.current_state
  END AS evaluate_status,
  l.last_status,
  ar.title,
  l.sensor,
  l.host,
  coalesce(l.alarm_name, ar.title) AS alarm_name,
  l.plugin_instance,
  l.type,
  l.type_instance,
  l.datasource,
  l.currentvalue,
  l.notification_description,
  l.site_name_from_alert,
  l.m_overlay,
  l.m_iface,
  -- keep your alarm_description CASE, replace atmp3.v -> l.atmp3_v, atmp7.v -> l.datasource
  case when coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)='operational_status' then 'Control Plane Down'
                               when  coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)='maya_temperature' then 'System Interval Temperature'
                               when coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)= 'metric_absence'  then 'Monitoring agent down'
                               when coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)= 'sdnc_node_cpu'  then 'SDNC Node Cpu High'
                               when coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)= 'sdnc_node_ram'  then 'SDNC Node Memory High'
                               when coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)= 'sdnc_node_disk'  then 'SDNC Node Disk High'
                               when  coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)='maya_ifstatus' then 'Interface Down'
                               when  coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)='maya_bfd' then 'Data Plane Down'
                               when  coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)='df' then 'High Disk Usage'
                               when  coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)='cpu' then 'CPU Utilization Exceeded'
                               when  coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)='alert_licence' then 'Alert Licence'
                               when  coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)='memory' then 'RAM Utilization Exceeded'
                               when  coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)='maya_probe' and l.datasource='avg_delay' then 'Delay'
                               when  coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)='maya_probe' and l.datasource='jitter' then 'Jitter'
                               when  coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)='maya_probe' and l.datasource='loss_percentage' then 'Packet Loss'
                               when  coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)='maya_system_services' then 'Service Down'
                               when  coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)='maya_dhcp_relay' then 'DHCP Server Unreachable'
                               when  coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)='maya_dhcp' then 'DHCP Lease Pool Exhaustion'
                               when  coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)='maya_bgp' then 'BGP Peer Down'
                               when  coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title)='ntp_out_of_sync' then 'NTP Out of Sync'
                               else coalesce(atmp3_v,ar.title) end alarm_description,
  trim(both '"' from (ar.annotations::jsonb->'alarm_id')::text) AS alarm_id,
  to_timestamp(ai.last_eval_time) AS time,
  to_timestamp(coalesce((l.max_date_num::double precision)/1e9, ai.current_state_since::double precision)) AS alert_time,
  round(extract(epoch from (now() - to_timestamp(coalesce((l.max_date_num::double precision)/1e9, ai.current_state_since::double precision))))/3600, 0) AS alert_time_since,
  CASE WHEN s.silenced_hash IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS silenced,
  CASE WHEN la.prev_state='alerting' AND la.new_state='normal' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END AS resolve_count,
  CASE WHEN lower(l.current_state)='alerting' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS alarm_count,
  CASE WHEN lower(l.current_state)='nodata'   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS nodata_count
FROM labels l
JOIN alert_instance ai
  ON ai.rule_uid = l.rule_uid AND ai.labels_hash = l.labels_hash
LEFT JOIN alert_rule ar ON ai.rule_uid = ar.uid
LEFT JOIN active_silenced s ON s.silenced_hash = l.labels_hash
LEFT JOIN last_anno la ON la.alert_id = ar.id
WHERE s.silenced_hash IS NULL
